data.name: Naazhim
data.gender_notes: Naazhim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root n-z-h, which means to support, aid, or help. The name Naazhim is derived from the verb nazaha, which means to help or assist. This name is a reminder of the importance of being a source of strength and support for others in times of need. The name Naazhim carries the meaning “Supporting, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naazhim usually hope their child will grow to embody supporting, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
